lines.x: Spain is withholding 12% of its olive oil output, taking roughly 188,000 tonnes off the market through September 2027 to prevent further declines in wholesale prices.
Shares of a major Spanish olive oil producer fell 23% following a 520 million euro acquisition deal.

Travel technology provider Amadeus reconfirmed its full-year revenue and margin targets at the lower end of its guided range, citing travel disruptions stemming from Middle East geopolitical tensions.
Spain's Transport Minister announced his resignation following two deadly high-speed rail crashes this year.
